descriptor: Account sign-in for a creative platform

voice.summary: Ember greets people by name and gets out of the way. It is short, warm and clear about what happens next, with a glow that never shouts.
dos: Name the sign-in method on each button
donts: Do not add marketing to a sign-in screen
Never ask for more than needed

taglines: Pick up where you left off
boilerplate: Ember is a creative platform whose sign-in screen welcomes returning users with one-tap Google and X sign-in and nothing else in the way.

microcopy.error: Could not sign you in. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No account found for that email.

logo.note: A small flame matches the name and warms a plain black sign-in screen.
